a1.label: Objective
a1.content: Improve printing time while preserving acceptable shell quality. This is a proposed experiment.

b1.label: Evidence
b1.content: No measured HUEVOS results yet. Record total time, waste and quality with a matched baseline.

c1.label: Constraints
c1.content: Two fixed nozzles have offsets; simultaneous deposition requires compatible trajectories.

d1.label: Acceptance
d1.content: Report observations and uncertainty; do not infer speedup without measurements.
